nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: I sealed the negative into its case at ten to ten. The accession book has not left this room since.

responses.text: Did you see anyone near the dome at quarter to eleven?

nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: Elias came down the dome stair at 22:45 with an empty sleeve under his arm. He said it was only a lens cloth.

nodes.speaker: scholar
nodes.text: I was in the chart archive at 22:45. The dome was locked, and I never borrowed its duplicate key.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The dynamo stayed steady all evening. I was with the machine at 22:45; its log will show you.
